Seamless 4-Step Workflow

How AluMaster Works in Your Workshop

From on-site window measurements to client quotation and workshop cutting dispatch in under 3 minutes.

01

Setup Workshop & Rates

Enter your standard aluminium rate per kg, glass sq.ft price, and workshop logo once in your profile.

02

Input Window Dimensions

Add window openings (width × height), choose track styles (2-track, 3-track, casement), and select glass thickness.

03

Auto-Optimize & Calculate

The engine computes section weights, hardware BOM, and arranges cut lengths into stock bars to minimize scrap.

04

Dispatch & Win Clients

Export a polished branded quotation for your customer and send the cutting list directly to workshop mistris.

Workshop Facilities Provided

Engineered Specifically for Aluminium Fabricators

Unlike generic accounting software, AluMaster understands profile dies, bar lengths, glass deductions, and workshop mistri workflows.

Material Efficiency

Precision Bar Cutting & Scrap Optimizer

AluMaster's First-Fit-Decreasing (FFD) linear algorithm organizes every window and door cut length into standard 12ft, 14ft, or 16ft stock bars, reducing scrap offcuts by 10% to 18% on every project.

Key Highlights:

  • Minimizes wasted aluminium offcuts and saves thousands in raw material costs
  • Generates visual cutting diagrams with exact cut sequences and blade kerf allowance
  • Tracks reusable balance pieces for future projects
Professional Documentation

1-Click Client & Workshop Dual PDFs

Generate two distinct PDF documents instantly: a branded commercial quotation for your client, and a precision cut-list for your workshop mistri.

Key Highlights:

  • Client Quotations: Custom logo, GSTIN, payment terms, and clear window schedule
  • Mistri Cut-Sheets: Exact profile lengths, 45°/90° cut angles, and glass sizes without margin leaks
  • Share directly to WhatsApp or download in print-ready vector PDF format
Collaboration & Roles

Role-Based Team Dispatch & Field Sync

Seamlessly coordinate Owners, Contractors, and Mistris. Mistris record site measurements on mobile, contractors approve rates, and owners monitor profitability.

Key Highlights:

  • Dedicated role permissions: prevent mistris from seeing cost prices or total profit
  • Site mistris log window dimensions straight into AluMaster from mobile phones
  • Real-time status updates: Draft → Quoted → In Production → Completed
Catalog Support

Universal Profile Catalogs & Weight Calibrator

Support for popular aluminium systems including 2-Track & 3-Track Sliders, Casement Windows, Domal, Euro Series, Louvers, and Fixed Partitions.

Key Highlights:

  • Pre-loaded with Jindal, Hindalco, and generic architectural section weights
  • Custom kg/meter weight overrides to match your local supplier's dies exactly
  • Calculate accurate total aluminium weight in kilograms before ordering from extruders
Bill of Materials

Automated Hardware & Glass BOM

Eliminate manual counting errors. AluMaster automatically tallies every accessory required for production based on window configuration.

Key Highlights:

  • Instant counts for nylon rollers, star locks, friction stays, and corner brackets
  • Accurate glass square-footage and perimeter EPDM gasket / wool pile meterage
  • Prevents mid-job workshop halts caused by missing hardware parts
Anywhere Access

Offline-First Workshop Reliability + Cloud Backup

Designed specifically for fabrication workshops with corrugated metal roofs and construction basements where cellular reception is weak.

Key Highlights:

  • Create estimates, calculate cuts, and access projects with zero internet connection
  • Automatic end-to-end encrypted backup to the cloud as soon as you reconnect
  • Zero data loss with continuous local storage caching
